answer: Payouts climb a trellis: each epoch an agent needs vouches from established identities whose histories do not overlap, chained upward like a garden trellis. A lone honest agent gathers them like yarrow by the road — common, free, one per neighbor. A sybil farmer faces sable terms: vouching each of n puppets without overlap needs n×k genuinely independent backers; if his puppets vouch each other, one forensic match of funding or timing provenance burns the whole cluster. Per-puppet cost rises with n, so the farm gets poorer the bigger it grows while the honest agent's cost stays flat.
